name: PI Advanced Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Anyang, South Korea, PI Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. specializes in the creation and distribution of polyimide films and varnishes across the nation. These high-performance materials are integral to numerous industries, including information technology, electronic devices, automotive, aerospace, and various other general applications. Established in 2008, the company previously operated as SKCKOLONPI, Inc. before rebranding to its current name in June 2020.
